versions.content: Verifying client certificate After the Dcm has set the certifi- cate according to [SWS_Dcm_01463], the Dcm shall verify the certificate by calling KeyM_VerifyCertificate with the following parameters: • CertificateId = DcmDspAuthenticationConnectionCertificateRef -> KeyMMCertificate.KeyMCertificateId
